question: In February 2023, who among the following was appointed as the external auditor of ILO for a four-year term?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GC Murmu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **GC Murmu** was appointed as the external auditor of the International Labour Organization (ILO) for a four-year term in February 2023.
 
• He is the current Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India.
 
• The appointment of GC Murmu as the external auditor is a significant achievement for India, reflecting the country's growing influence in international organizations.
 
• The role of the external auditor involves auditing the financial statements of the ILO and ensuring that the organization’s funds are used efficiently and effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The International Labour Organization (ILO) is a United Nations agency dealing with labour issues, particularly international labour standards, social protection, and work opportunities for all.
 
• Established in 1919, the ILO is the only tripartite U.N. agency that brings together governments, employers, and workers of 187 member states to set labour standards, develop policies, and devise programs promoting decent work for all women and men.
 
• The ILO's primary goal is to promote rights at work, encourage decent employment opportunities, enhance social protection, and strengthen dialogue on work-related issues.
